subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: What canonical activity/progress contract should the Control UI use for long or multi-agent runs: the full gateway session activity/attention API, a narrower UI-only interim strip, or the newer task-ledger/dashboard surfaces?
rationale: The gap is real, but the remaining work defines user-visible phase semantics and likely public Gateway/session events rather than a narrow bug repair; related implementation PRs also disagree on scope and remain open or only partially landed.

options.title: Approve gateway-backed activity contract
options.body: Define the activity/attention fields, event/resync behavior, and minimal Control UI strip before merging more UI progress work.

options.title: Ship a UI-only interim strip
options.body: Allow a smaller Control UI presentation using existing coarse events while keeping the broader Gateway activity API tracked separately.

options.title: Defer behind the backend issue
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause UI work until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 settles the source-of-truth contract.

recommendation.title: Approve gateway-backed activity contract
recommendation.body: Define the activity/attention fields, event/resync behavior, and minimal Control UI strip before merging more UI progress work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the live canonical activity-contract issue and is the best routing candidate for the Gateway/session semantics decision.
